description: Create an email-receipt test in MailVakt. Takes an optional expected sender domain; returns a test ID, unique recipient address and expiry time. The user must send a test message to that address before expiry, then use get_inbox_test to read the result. Creates a new test on each call. Does not send email or measure inbox-versus-spam placement at Gmail, Outlook or other mailbox providers.

expected_from_domain.description: The domain the test email will be sent from, e.g. example.com

name: start_inbox_test
title: Start inbox test
